contract.intent: Build the small event-validation system — a configurable rules runner (S4 validators seed): rules registry + config (enable/disable, severity, thresholds) + report. Secures the flow deterministically; the gate/resolution/schema checks become managed rules, not hardcoded script logic.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/validate.mjs — runs the active rules against the tree; grouped report by severity; exit code by worst severity
scripts/validation.config.json — rule config: {id, enabled, severity, params}; management surface (tune/disable without code changes)

Rules registry covers: gate-1 (work requires confirmed grill), gate-2 (completed requires confirmed confirm), event schema, one-current-per-name, resolution files-exist, depth budget, name discipline, card presence
Each rule: id, defaultSeverity, description, check(tree) → findings[]
Config can disable a rule or override severity (e.g., depth = warning in quick mode)
Task done with running system; reported against the live tree
